examples.en: Add a splash of vinegar to bring out the flavor of the salad.
examples.zh: 加少许醋以激发沙拉的风味。

examples.en: Rice vinegar is a staple seasoning in Chinese cooking.
examples.zh: 米醋是中餐的基础调料。

words.usage: 不可数名词「醋」。词源法语 vin（酒）＋aigre（酸），「变酸的酒」，助记拼写。搭配 rice vinegar 米醋、malt vinegar 麦芽醋。派生 vinegary adj. 酸的。
words.mnemonic: vin(酒 wine)＋egar(酸) → 酒放酸成醋

examples.en: Heat the oil and fry the chopped garlic until golden.
examples.zh: 热油，把蒜末煎至金黄。

examples.en: Studies suggest that garlic may help lower blood pressure.
examples.zh: 研究表明大蒜或有助降低血压。

words.usage: 不可数名词「大蒜」，无复数。量词表达：a clove of garlic 一瓣蒜、a head of garlic 一头蒜。搭配 crush garlic 捣蒜。派生 garlicky adj. 有蒜味的。
collocations: a clove of garlic 一瓣蒜
words.mnemonic: gar(矛)＋lic(葱 leek) → 叶尖如矛之葱 → 蒜

examples.en: When asked about his plans, he merely shrugged his shoulders.
examples.zh: 被问及计划时，他只是耸了耸肩。

examples.en: The company shrugged off the criticism and pressed ahead.
examples.zh: 公司对批评不屑一顾，继续推进。

words.usage: 动词「耸肩」表不知道或无所谓：shrug one's shoulders；名词 a shrug。高频短语 shrug off 不屑一顾、摆脱（批评）：shrug off criticism。
collocations: shrug off criticism 对批评不屑一顾
give a shrug 耸一下肩
words.mnemonic: sh(嘘)＋rug(毯) → 噤声耸肩裹紧毯子

words.definition: adj. 天主教的；广泛的 n. 天主教徒

examples.en: The Catholic Church still plays a major role in the country's education.
examples.zh: 天主教会在该国教育中仍扮演重要角色。

examples.en: He has catholic tastes, enjoying everything from jazz to opera.
examples.zh: 他趣味广泛，从爵士到歌剧无所不爱。

words.usage: 大写为「天主教的」，名词「天主教徒」：Roman Catholic。小写 catholic 意为「广泛的」：catholic tastes 广泛的爱好，考研曾考。反义相关词 Protestant。
collocations: devout Catholic 虔诚的天主教徒
words.mnemonic: cathol(全体)＋ic → 包容全体 → 广泛；大写指天主教的

words.definition: n. 鹤；起重机；vt. 伸长（脖子）

examples.en: A crane stood motionless in the shallow water hunting fish.
examples.zh: 一只鹤在浅水中一动不动地伺机捕鱼。

examples.en: Two cranes lifted the steel beams to the top of the tower.
examples.zh: 两台起重机把钢梁吊上塔顶。

words.usage: 名词两义：「鹤」与「起重机」（吊臂似鹤颈得名）；动词 crane one's neck 伸长脖子看。搭配 tower crane 塔吊、red-crowned crane 丹顶鹤。
collocations: crane one's neck 伸长脖子
words.mnemonic: 吊臂曲颈如鹤——一词兼指鹤与吊车

examples.en: The region is rich in iron ore and high-quality coal.
examples.zh: 该地区富藏铁矿石和优质煤。

examples.en: The plant smelts raw ore into pure metal around the clock.
examples.zh: 该厂昼夜不停地把原矿冶炼成纯金属。

words.usage: 不可数名词「矿石、矿砂」，矿物与经济类阅读高频：iron ore 铁矿石、ore deposit 矿床；动词 smelt ore 冶炼矿石。与 or（连词）同音，听力靠语境区分。gold ore 金矿石。
words.mnemonic: 挖到矿「哦嚎(o)…真热(re)」——得高温冶炼

words.definition: aux. 将要；应该（法律义务）…好吗

examples.en: Shall we go over the plan once more before the meeting?
examples.zh: 会前我们再过一遍方案好吗？

examples.en: The tenant shall pay the rent on the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 承租人应于每月首日支付租金。

words.usage: 情态动词：shall I / we 用于建议或征询；用于第二、三人称表义务「必须」，是法律文本标配，考研翻译译作「应、须」：The buyer shall pay... 英式口语缩略 shan't＝shall not。
words.mnemonic: 法律条文里 shall＝「应」，比 should 更硬

words.definition: n. 裙子；（复）郊区，边缘；vt. 绕开，回避

examples.en: She bought a long cotton skirt for the summer.
examples.zh: 她买了一条夏日穿的长棉裙。

examples.en: The article skillfully skirted the most controversial question.
examples.zh: 文章巧妙地回避了最具争议的问题。

words.usage: 名词「裙子」；复数 skirts 指「边缘、郊区」；及物动词「绕开、回避」：skirt the issue 回避问题，考研阅读高频。on the skirts of the city 在市郊。
collocations: skirt the issue 回避问题
on the skirts of the city 在市郊
words.mnemonic: 裙摆绕腿转 → 绕开问题；裙之所及即边缘

words.definition: n. 诱饵，诱惑物；vt. 诱惑，引诱

examples.en: High salaries lured many young graduates to the coastal city.
examples.zh: 高薪把许多年轻毕业生吸引到这座沿海城市。

examples.en: The lure of easy profits led investors into the scheme.
examples.zh: 轻松获利的诱惑把投资者引入了该骗局。

words.usage: 名词「诱饵；诱惑物」：the lure of easy money 不义之财的诱惑；及物动词 lure sb into doing sth 诱使某人做某事，常含贬义，多指引入圈套。形近词 allure 魅力，注意区分。
collocations: lure sb into a trap 诱人入陷阱
the lure of money 金钱的诱惑
words.mnemonic: l＋ure 谐音「有饵」——有饵才上钩

examples.en: He seldom watches television, preferring to read in the evenings.
examples.zh: 他很少看电视，晚上更爱读书。

examples.en: Seldom have the two sides reached an agreement so quickly.
examples.zh: 双方很少如此迅速地达成协议。

words.usage: 频度副词「很少」，比 rarely 更书面；自带否定义，不可再与 not 连用；句首须部分倒装：Seldom does he complain，考研语法高频。
collocations: seldom if ever 几乎从不
seldom or never 简直从不
seldom go out 很少外出
words.mnemonic: sel(少)＋dom(家门) → 很少进家门

words.definition: n. 棉花；棉布，棉线；adj. 棉制的

examples.en: Cotton remains the most widely used natural fiber in the world.
examples.zh: 棉花仍是世界上使用最广的天然纤维。

examples.en: These shirts are made of pure cotton and feel very soft.
examples.zh: 这些衬衫是纯棉的，手感很软。

words.usage: 不可数名词「棉花；棉布；棉线」，形容词「棉制的」：a cotton shirt。搭配 cotton gin 轧棉机（美国史高频）、pure cotton 纯棉。
collocations: cotton on to 领悟明白
words.mnemonic: 谐音「卡通」——卡通图案印在棉布上

words.definition: n. 孤儿；vt. 使成为孤儿；adj. 孤儿的

examples.en: The war orphaned thousands of children in the region.
examples.zh: 战争使该地区成千上万的孩子沦为孤儿。

examples.en: She was orphaned at the age of five and raised by an aunt.
examples.zh: 她五岁时失去双亲，由姑妈抚养长大。

words.usage: 名词「孤儿」；及物动词「使沦为孤儿」，常被动：be orphaned at an early age 幼年失怙，新闻语体常见。派生 orphanage n. 孤儿院。
collocations: be orphaned young 幼年失怙
words.mnemonic: 谐音「饿饭」——孤儿缺爹娘少饭吃

words.definition: n. 后果；余波；（灾后的）时期

examples.en: Thousands were left homeless in the aftermath of the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震过后，数以千计的人无家可归。

examples.en: In the aftermath of the scandal, several officials resigned.
examples.zh: 丑闻余波未平，几名官员引咎辞职。

words.usage: 名词「（灾祸后的）后果、余波期」，几乎总与 in the aftermath of 连用：in the aftermath of the earthquake，考研写作的地道表达。
collocations: in the aftermath of the war 战后时期
words.mnemonic: after(之后)＋math(割草) → 割后的乱摊子 → 余波

examples.en: He warmed a small glass of brandy by the fire.
examples.zh: 他在炉边温了一小杯白兰地。

examples.en: The chef added a splash of brandy to the sauce.
examples.zh: 大厨在酱汁里加了少许白兰地。

words.usage: 不可数名词「白兰地」，由葡萄酒蒸馏而成的烈酒，词源 brandywine＝burnt wine「烧酒」，可助记。a glass of brandy 一杯白兰地；brandy glass 白兰地杯。餐饮与文学阅读偶见。
collocations: a glass of brandy 一杯白兰地
words.mnemonic: brandy＝burnt wine「烧酒」→ 白兰地

examples.en: The prisoners are allowed one hour of outdoor exercise a day.
examples.zh: 囚犯每天获准一小时户外活动。

examples.en: He was held prisoner by rebel forces for over three months.
examples.zh: 他被叛军囚禁了三个多月。

words.usage: 可数名词「囚犯、俘虏」：a prisoner of war 战俘、be taken prisoner 被俘、hold sb prisoner 囚禁某人。喻义 a prisoner of one's habits。
collocations: hold sb prisoner 囚禁某人
words.mnemonic: prison(监狱)＋er → 蹲监狱之人

examples.en: A 15-watt LED bulb can light the whole room.
examples.zh: 一只 15 瓦的 LED 灯泡就能照亮整个房间。

examples.en: The power of the motor is rated at 750 watts.
examples.zh: 该电机的额定功率为 750 瓦。

words.usage: 名词「瓦特」，功率单位，源自蒸汽机改良者 James Watt 的姓氏。复合词 kilowatt 千瓦、wattage 瓦数。注意与电压单位 volt 伏特、电流单位 ampere 安培区分，科技英语常三者并现。
words.mnemonic: 人名 Watt 音译「瓦特」→ 功率单位

examples.en: A golden eagle soared above the valley in search of prey.
examples.zh: 金雕在山谷上空翱翔觅食。

examples.en: The bald eagle serves as the national emblem of the United States.
examples.zh: 白头海雕是美国的国徽图案。

words.usage: 可数名词「雕、鹰」，体型大于 hawk。bald eagle 白头海雕是美国国家象征。习语 eagle eye 锐利目光：keep an eagle eye on 密切注视。
words.mnemonic: 美国国鸟白头海雕，eagle eye 鹰眼盯得紧

examples.en: The province grows wheat on vast stretches of flat farmland.
examples.zh: 该省在广阔平整的农田上种植小麦。

examples.en: Poor harvests pushed global wheat prices to a record high.
examples.zh: 歉收把全球小麦价格推至历史新高。

words.usage: 不可数名词「小麦」，农业经济类高频：wheat fields 麦田、wheat exports 小麦出口、whole-wheat bread 全麦面包。近类谷物 barley 大麦、oats 燕麦。
words.mnemonic: w＋heat(热) → 麦子晒足热浪才成粮

examples.en: The new stadium can hold eighty thousand spectators.
examples.zh: 新体育场可容纳八万名观众。

examples.en: Fans filled the stadium hours before the final began.
examples.zh: 决赛开始数小时前，球迷就坐满了体育场。

words.usage: 可数名词「（有看台的）体育场」，复数 stadiums 或 stadia。搭配 an Olympic stadium 奥运场馆、a packed stadium 座无虚席。
collocations: an Olympic stadium 奥运体育场
packed stadium 座无虚席的体育场
words.mnemonic: stand(看台)＋ium → 层层看台围出的场馆

examples.en: The cliff path offers spectacular views of the coastline.
examples.zh: 悬崖小径可俯瞰壮丽的海岸线。

examples.en: Negotiators warned that the economy was heading toward a fiscal cliff.
examples.zh: 谈判者警告经济正滑向财政悬崖。

words.usage: 可数名词「悬崖、峭壁」，海岸与地质描写高频。习语 cliff-hanger 扣人心弦的局面；财经热词 fiscal cliff 财政悬崖。搭配 a steep cliff 陡崖。
words.mnemonic: cli(climb 爬)＋ff → 只能徒手攀爬的绝壁
